thread:
elaine: Quick sync — we need a crisp handoff pattern for partner SEVs (marketplace + HW partners). Current asks: (1) shared channel vs dedicated war room, (2) oncall rotations, (3) when to escalate to SRE/eng, (4) postmortem ownership.

matt: +1. We had confusion last month with the HW partner bridge. Suggest a small playbook we can link into the partner onboarding doc.

suresh: I can draft the contact tree. For immediate ops: could we standardize a single shared channel `#partners-sev` and then spawn ephemeral war-rooms for high-sev? That keeps history in one place and reduces missed pings.

anna: I prefer a dedicated shared channel per partner cohort (eg `#partner-marketplace` + `#partner-hw`) to reduce noise, but war-rooms for sev1/2 only. We should record rotation owners in the channel topic.

chris_oncall: Practical ops note: when a SEV1 hits, SRE gets pager. Partner channel should have a pinned message with an "activate war-room" snippet so anyone can create the bridge quickly. Example command we used:

```
/warroom create --title "Partner SEV1: <partner>" --bridge #partners-war 
post: @oncall-sre @eng-runtime @partnerships
```

elaine: Good — let's include that snippet. Also need clear thresholds: when partner reports degraded onboarding flow vs. production outage. Draft suggestion:
- SEV1: customer-facing outage affecting >10% or critical marketplace listing down
- SEV2: degraded performance for a subset or scheduled marketplace deploy failure
- SEV3: non-urgent/backend alerts or integration questions

matt: For escalation tree, propose: partner_support -> partnerships lead (elaine) -> oncall-sre (chris_oncall) -> eng-runtime pager -> engineering EM on-call -> exec on-call if >4 hours unresolved. Also include a parallel path to product for release blockers.

suresh: I'll add partner-side contacts. We need an explicit SLA for acknowledgement: 15m for SEV1, 60m for SEV2. Can we add an automated ack from partner_support_bot that posts into the channel when a ticket is created?

partner_support_bot: automated: New partner ticket created: PT-1123 (marketplace). Severity: SEV2. Assigned: suresh. Link: https://zendesk.example/pt-1123

anna: Nice. For rotations: let's publish a weekly rotation calendar and a short runbook with checkboxes:
- `@oncall-sre` page + confirm receipt
- create war-room bridge + invite partner rep
- collect logs + last successful deploy hash
- toggle fallback routing if necessary
- audit log entry + postmortem owner assignment

chris_oncall: I'll put a minimal runbook into Confluence and pin the URL in the channel topic. Also propose a short command to generate the war-room and tag everyone:

```
/warroom quick "<partner>" --severity SEV1 --notify oncall-sre,eng-runtime,partnerships
```

elaine: Postmortem ownership: for partner-impacting incidents, partnerships + eng-runtime share responsibility: partnerships own partner comms, eng-runtime owns root cause + mitigation and ops logs. Postmortem must include CI/CD hashes, marketplace deployment id, and partner correlation id.

matt: Ops checklist for handoff between business hours and off-hours: whoever is active should run a quick health-check script and post results in the thread: `scripts/partner_health_check.sh <partner-id>` — script outputs service status, last deploy time, and token validity.

chris_oncall: If the partner is on dedicated infra (Dedicated/Private), include infra owner in the first 15m. If it's hosted, follow the normal SRE -> eng path.

elaine: Action items:
- suresh: draft contact tree + SLA ack text (due EOD tomorrow)
- chris_oncall: confluence runbook + quick warroom command (due 48h)
- matt: add `#partners-sev` channel topic template and rotation calendar (due EOW)
- anna: decide cohort channel approach and update onboarding checklist (due EOW)

suresh: noted. I'll ping partners for their oncall names and preferred bridge tool.

partner_support_bot: automated: Reminder: fill in the channel topic with rotation owners. Template: "Oncall: @person | War-room command pinned | Contact tree link"

anna: One more ask — marketing/announce syncs: any planned joint announcements should have a liaison assigned in the same channel so we don't get surprised during an integration deploy. Tag `@product-comm` for those.

elaine: Agreed. We'll call this the 'Partner SEV Handoff - Minimal Playbook'. I'll collate the docs once action items are complete and push to the partner onboarding repo. Thanks all :thumbsup:

matt: +1. If anyone runs into blockers while drafting, start the war-room and loop me in.

chris_oncall: I'll own the first live drill to validate the flow next week.

suresh: Sending initial contact sheet now to the thread (private link).

elaine: Closing notes: keep the war-room short and focused, always assign postmortem owner before closing. We can iterate after the first real SEV.

partner_support_bot: automated: Thread archived after 90 days of inactivity.
